Name: King Slime
Summoning:
Manual: King Slime can be summoned by using the Slime Crown, in any biome at any time. Random: King Slime has a 1/300 (0.33%) chance of naturally spawning while the following conditions are met: - The potential spawn point is located in one of the outer lateral sixths of the map (the far left or far right). - The depth at its potential spawn point is above zero. - It is daytime. - King Slime is not currently alive in the world. - The player is not in a Graveyard biome. - There is no water or less than 1 tile of water above its potential spawn point. - There must be standard, green grass at its potential spawn point (off-screen; see NPC spawning)
If the spawn succeeds, King Slime will spawn in a random place around the player and not necessarily on this grass block. - If the spawn succeeds, King Slime will spawn in a random place around the player and not necessarily on this grass block. Slime Rain: If 150 slimes are killed by players, NPCs, traps, lava, and/or summoned minions during the Slime Rain event, King Slime spawns. The following slimes will count toward this total as long as they are killed during the event: Baby Slime, Black Slime, Blue Slime, Green Slime, Jungle Slime, Pinky, Purple Slime, Red Slime, and Yellow Slime. Statue-spawned slimes are eligible as well. Defeating King Slime ends the event shortly after. If all players die, King Slime despawns, and the event continues for some time before ending on its own (between 9 and 15 in-game hours). If King Slime has already been defeated in a world, it only takes 75 slime kills to spawn him. If King Slime is summoned manually with the Slime Crown and then subsequently killed, while the Slime Rain is active, the event ends in the same way as if the player killed the King Slime that naturally spawns at the end of the event. This can be quite helpful for players in later stages of the game who want to get the Slime Rain event over with as quickly as possible. Remix: In Remix worlds, killing a slime has a 1/200 (0.5%) chance of spawning King Slime, provided the boss has not yet been defeated, is not already alive, and at least one player has more than 140 maximum health and more than 8 defense. Only the death of certain types of slime can trigger this: Baby Slime, Black Slime, Blue Slime, Green Slime, Jungle Slime, Pinky, Purple Slime, Red Slime, and Yellow Slime. Statue-spawned slimes are eligible as well. Slimes killed without the player dealing damage to them will not spawn King Slime.

Name: Eye of Cthulhu
Summoning:
Manual: The Eye of Cthulhu can be summoned manually using a Suspicious Looking Eye at night (from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM). Only one Eye of Cthulhu can be summoned manually at a time. Random: The Eye of Cthulhu can also spawn naturally at the start of the night. Its arrival when spawning naturally is announced by the status message “You feel an evil presence watching you...”. In order for the boss to spawn naturally, the following conditions must be fulfilled at dusk (7:30 PM): - The Eye of Cthulhu has not yet been defeated in the current world or no placed Demon/Crimson Altars exist in the current world. - At least one player in the world has at least 200 maximum health and at least 11 defense. - At least four town NPCs are present in the world. While the Old Man, Traveling Merchant, and town pets count towards this total, the Skeleton Merchant does not. - No boss is already alive. - None of the following events are active: Lantern Night, Old One's Army, Pumpkin Moon, or Frost Moon. - Time is not being accelerated by the Enchanted Sundial or Enchanted Moondial. If the conditions are met, there is a 1/3 (33.33%) chance for the Eye of Cthulhu to spawn.[a] Provided the roll succeeds, the status message appears and a hidden countdown of 1 minute 21 seconds begins. The Eye of Cthulhu spawns at the end of the countdown, at 8:51 PM. Another check is performed at that time, with all of the following conditions needing to be fulfilled in order for the boss to spawn: - At least one player is in the surface or Space layer.
Consequently, the natural spawning of the Eye of Cthulhu can easily be prevented by remaining in a layer lower than the surface for the night. Returning to the surface before dawn will cause it to spawn as normal.
This restriction is lifted in worlds where the world spawn point is below the surface, such as worlds with the special world seed Remix active or the secret world seed Mole people. The Eye of Cthulhu can spawn naturally in those worlds regardless of the player's position, whether they are above or below the surface. - Consequently, the natural spawning of the Eye of Cthulhu can easily be prevented by remaining in a layer lower than the surface for the night. Name: Wall of Flesh
KbResist: 20%/28%/36% (1 player)69% (2 players)79% (3 players)86%  (4 players)100% (5 players or more) (1 player)72% (2 players)82% (3 players)88% (4 players)100% (5 players or more)
Summoning: The Wall of Flesh can be summoned by dropping a Guide Voodoo Doll into lava in The Underworld while the Guide is alive, which destroys the Guide Voodoo Doll and kills the Guide in the process. Alternatively, the boss can also be summoned by letting the Guide die within lava in The Underworld. He can die by any means (the player, an enemy, or the environment), as long as he is touching lava when he dies. The Wall of Flesh is summoned just beyond the player's screen on the side where the Guide Voodoo Doll was dropped into lava (or where the Guide was killed by lava), then moves in the direction of the player. As a general rule, it spawns at least 75 tiles away from the player. Technical details: When the Guide Voodoo Doll is destroyed or the Guide is killed in lava, the game checks whether all players are horizontally at least 75 tiles away from the location of the doll/Guide. If they are, then the Wall of Flesh is spawned at that horizontal position. Otherwise, the game moves one tile towards the closest lateral world border and checks again, repeating this until it encounters a tile that is horizontally at least 75 tiles away from any player. It stops 20 tiles before the true world border (i.e. 21/22 tiles away from the visible world border), even if a player is still within 75 tiles at that point (e.g. standing directly against the visible world border). After locating the horizontal spawn position, the game determines a valid vertical position. The spawning tile must not be occupied by a solid block and its liquid level must not exceed 100 (i.e. at most approx. 39% of the tile can contain liquid). Again, the game begins at the vertical position of the doll/Guide and checks if that location is valid. Then it checks one tile above that spot and one tile below it, then two tiles above and two tiles below, and so on, until finding a valid spot. If the game finds no valid spot after 1000 attempts (i.e. 1000 tiles above and below), then it reverts to the initial vertical position. Finally, the vertical limits are enforced: If the vertical position that was encountered is higher than 10 tiles below the Cavern–Underworld border, it is forcibly moved down to that position (even though the tile there was not considered valid before), and if it is lower than 80 tiles below that border (roughly the vertical center of the Underworld), it is forcibly moved up to that position (again, even though the tile at that position was not considered valid before). The center of the Wall of Flesh's mouth appears at the determined location, and the eyes are spawned relative to it. The boss quickly aligns itself vertically with the player after spawning.

Name: Plantera
Summoning: After all three mechanical bosses have been defeated, Plantera's Bulbs will randomly spawn in the Underground Jungle (indicated by the status message "The jungle grows restless..."). These bulbs emit a faint pink light in dark areas and immediately summon Plantera nearby upon being destroyed, usually a fair distance off-screen.
ExpertMode: In Expert Mode, there are a few significant differences in Plantera's attacks, aside from the default increased health and damage. In the first form, her pink Seeds can travel through blocks, and all projectiles have limited homing capabilities. The cooldowns are also decreased: In her second form, Plantera and Plantera's Tentacles move faster than normal. In addition, there are nine more Plantera's Tentacles, attached to Plantera's Hooks in groups of three. Furthermore, the eight tentacles that are attached to Plantera's body can respawn after they have been killed (this does not apply to the tentacles on the hooks). The rate is randomized, but it depends on the number of tentacles that are alive – if all tentacles are destroyed, a new tentacle spawns after 5 seconds, on average. This is increased by 5 seconds per living tentacle, hence it takes an average of 180 seconds for all eight tentacles to fully respawn. A single defeated tentacle will take 40 seconds to respawn, on average, assuming the other seven tentacles remain alive for the duration.

Name: Golem
Summoning: Golem is summoned by using a Lihzahrd Power Cell at the Lihzahrd Altar located in the final chamber of the Jungle Temple, at any time, and only if the current world is in Hardmode after Plantera is defeated. Upon pressing ⚷ Open / Activate on the Lihzahrd Altar, one Lihzahrd Power Cell is consumed from the player's inventory and Golem is summoned directly above the altar. The Lihzahrd Altar can be relocated after being mined with a Picksaw or better. However, Golem will become enraged while outside of the Underground Jungle.

Name: Duke Fishron
Summoning: Duke Fishron is summoned by fishing in the Ocean at any time, using a Truffle Worm as bait (see Notes for details). Once the bobber bobs, reeling in the line spawns Duke Fishron, who emerges from the water, pauses for a moment, and then begins attacking the player. Duke Fishron is invulnerable during his summoning animation. Duke Fishron himself does not require any bosses to be defeated prior, meaning he can be summoned earlier than his intended stage of progression, and that Truffle Worms brought to a new world can be used to summon him.

Name: Lunatic Cultist
Summoning: The Lunatic Cultist is summoned after killing the Cultists that spawn at the Dungeon's entrance after Skeletron and Golem have been defeated.

Name: Moon Lord
Summoning: The Moon Lord will spawn after destroying the four Celestial Pillars or can be summoned manually using a Celestial Sigil in any world where Golem has been defeated. The status message “Impending doom approaches...” indicates the Moon Lord's spawning countdown. During the countdown, the screen will go dim and all objects, tiles, and walls will oscillate back and forth, and then go back to normal, and the sound volume will gradually decrease, eventually becoming completely silent. If the Moon Lord is spawned by destroying the Celestial Pillars, it takes 60 seconds for him to spawn, and the screen effect will appear 5 times; each time the screen will go darker and all objects and walls will oscillate more violently. If using a Celestial Sigil to summon the Moon Lord, it takes 12 seconds for him to spawn, and the screen effect will only appear once.

Name: Empress of Light
Summoning: The Empress of Light is summoned by killing a Prismatic Lacewing, at any time. Prismatic Lacewings spawn in The Hallow on the Surface between dusk (7:30 PM) and midnight (12:00 AM) once Plantera has been defeated. They can be caught with a Bug Net (or its upgrades), then released elsewhere and killed by the player. If released outside of the Hallow, a Prismatic Lacewing will disappear almost immediately. The Empress of Light herself does not require any bosses to be defeated prior, meaning she can be summoned earlier than her intended stage of progression, and that Prismatic Lacewings brought to a new world can be used to summon her.
